name: Akase Kyouya
source:
[i]"That's why I think that even if the traitor is among us, we can get them on our side."[/i]

A student who attends Ariake Technical School. He's an honest, athletic, and energetic guy with a strong devotion, leading him to be quite influential on the group’s mood. 

[From [url=http://ideafintl.com/charade-maniacs/chara/?page=ch1]Idea Factory International[/url]]
